title: Proposal: wizard remove on click icons handling
symptom: The Bolus Calculator wizard has icon indicators that toggle settings on click, but users may not understand they are checkboxes, may click them accidentally, and changes are stored and used in subsequent calculations, risking accidental parameter changes.
evidence_quote: On click of an item it toggles the setting, however, I see some risk with the implementation: * From a UX/UI perspective, users will not intuitive understand that it is actual checkboxes * They are close the cancel button and can be clicked accidentally * When toggled, the setting will be stored, and used in the next calculation too
